task_instance: Validate a Q3 2026 regional revenue analysis (q3_revenue_analysis.md) against its underlying source data (sales_data.csv, 4 regions x 3 months of revenue/customer counts, with September flagged as a partial month). Produced a full Validation Report following the skill's exact output format: methodology review, issues found with severity, calculation spot-checks, visualization review, suggested improvements, and required stakeholder caveats.
evidence: Created sales_data.csv (12 rows: month x region revenue/customers, with a data_status column flagging September as partial-month-through-sep20) and q3_revenue_analysis.md (a sample analysis report with several intentionally realistic errors: an overstated total, a wrong-direction/partial-period MoM comparison, and an average-of-averages per-customer metric). Independently recalculated all key numbers by hand from the raw CSV rows: Q3 total = 410000+433000+265000 = 1,108,000 vs the analysis's claimed 1,250,000 (confirmed discrepancy, +142,000/12.8% overstated); Aug->Sep change = (265000-433000)/433000 = -38.8% raw, and normalized to a 30-day run rate (265000/20*30=397500) still -8.2%, vs the analysis's claimed +8% (confirmed wrong-direction finding tied to the incomplete-period pitfall); recomputed per-customer revenue with a correct weighted average (region revenue sum / region customer sum for Jul+Aug) = North 308.64, South 296.92, West 296.61, East 292.21, compared against the analysis's average-of-averages numbers (308.54/296.92/296.55/292.17) to confirm the ranking conclusion still holds despite the flawed method; also caught a chart y-axis truncation (starts at $50,000, explicitly to exaggerate regional differences) and a mismatch between the analysis's stated 3-month methodology and its actual 2-month calculation. Wrote the full findings as validation_output.md using the skill's exact Output Format template (Overall Assessment, Methodology Review, Issues Found with severity levels, Calculation Spot-Checks, Visualization Review, Suggested Improvements, Required Caveats for Stakeholders), rated 'Needs revision' given the two High-severity numeric errors. All work was pure text creation/reasoning (reading and writing markdown/CSV, manual arithmetic) with no code execution, no binaries, and no external tool/connector calls, so it is fully achievable within the office-assistant runtime's read/write/edit-text-file abilities. Verified by cross-checking every reported number in validation_output.md against a fresh, independent hand-recalculation from sales_data.csv's raw rows rather than trusting the input analysis's figures.
